relationships.basis: Camurus identifies FluidCrystal as its proprietary lipid-based long-acting injection depot technology.

Camurus and Rhythm announced a license agreement (2016) for an extended-release FluidCrystal formulation of setmelanotide (CAM4072); Rhythm's FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-02-26) confirms the relationship while disclosing that active development of that specific weekly formulation is paused in favor of RM-718. No evidence found that the license itself was terminated or reverted.

source.label: Rhythm and Camurus Announce License Agreement for Extended Release FluidCrystal Setmelanotide, 2016
